name: payments-billing
title: Payments, billing and commerce
summary: Take money correctly: checkout integration, subscriptions and entitlements, usage billing, invoices and tax, refunds, disputes and fraud, ledger and reconciliation, and catalog, cart, inventory and fulfillment.
useWhen: Integrate Stripe or Paddle checkout into the app
Add subscriptions with trials, upgrades, downgrades and cancellation
A customer says they were charged twice, or paid but has no access
Handle payment webhooks and keep our database in sync with the provider
Do I need to charge VAT or sales tax, and how do I invoice?
We are getting chargebacks or card-testing attacks
Failed renewals are costing us revenue
Build a product catalog, cart, inventory and order fulfillment
Reconcile payouts with what our database says we earned

notFor.topic: What to charge, plan design and pricing strategy
PCI DSS scope, SAQ and consumer-law rules on renewal and cancellation
Bookkeeping, revenue recognition and tax filing
Cancellation save offers and churn reduction

references.title: Payment provider and checkout integration

Use hosted checkout or provider-hosted fields so card data never touches your servers
Create the payment server-side from item IDs, never client-computed amounts
Treat the provider webhook, not the browser redirect, as the source of truth
Use one idempotency key per attempt so retries, reloads and second tabs never double-charge
Call Stripe from Rust with a pinned async-stripe or typed reqwest, verifying webhooks
Handle 3-D Secure and asynchronous payment states correctly
Resolve an unknown outcome after a timeout by querying, never re-charging
Offer Apple Pay, Google Pay and local payment methods per market
Add a second processor with portable payment tokens for uptime and freeze risk
